14312: _handle_bot() {
14313:     local cmd="$1" mid="$2" text="$3" state="$4"
14314: 
14315:     if [ "$cmd" = "STATE_INPUT" ]; then
14316:         rm -f "$STATE_FILE"
14317:         if [ "$state" = "wait_restart_router_confirm" ]; then
14318:             local input; input=$(printf "%s" "$text" | tr -d '\r\n\t ')
14319:             if [ "$input" = "YES" ]; then
14320:                 send_message "$(printf '%s <b>Перезагрузка %s…</b>\nБот возобновит работу примерно через минуту.' "$E_OFF" "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/hostname 2>/dev/null || echo "Роутер")")" ""
14321:                 logger -t podkop-bot "[Restart Router] Manual reboot requested via Telegram"
14322:                 sleep 2
14323:                 reboot
14324:             else
14325:                 delete_message "$mid"
14326:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Перезагрузка отменена. Введено: <code>%s</code>' "$E_BACK" "$(html_escape "$input")")" \
14327:                     "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"cmd_maintenance\"}]]}"
14328:             fi
14329:             return
14330:         elif [ "$state" = "wait_custom_proxy" ]; then
14331:             delete_message "$mid"
14332:             local safe_link=$(printf "%s" "$text" | tr -d '\r\n\t ')
14333:             if echo "$safe_link" | grep -qE '^(http|https|socks5|socks5h)://'; then
14334:                 uci set podkop_bot.settings.custom_proxy="$safe_link"; uci_commit_safe podkop_bot
14335:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Прокси бота сохранён.' "$E_OK")" ""
14336:                 _handle_fallback_socks "net_proxies_menu" "" "" ""
14337:             else
14338:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Адрес должен начинаться с http://, https://, socks5:// или socks5h://' "$E_ERR")" \
14339:                     "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"net_proxies_menu\"}]]}"
14340:             fi
14341:         elif [ "$state" = "wait_bind_iface" ]; then
14342:             delete_message "$mid"
14343:             local safe_iface=$(printf "%s" "$text" | tr -d '\r\n')
14344:             if echo "$safe_iface" | grep -q '[[:space:]]'; then
14345:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Имя интерфейса содержит пробелы.' "$E_ERR")" \
14346:                     "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"bot_settings\"}]]}"
14347:             elif ! ip link show "$safe_iface" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
14348:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Интерфейс <code>%s</code> не существует.' "$E_ERR" "$safe_iface")" \
14349:                     "{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Назад\",\"callback_data\":\"bot_settings\"}]]}"
14350:             else
14351:                 uci set podkop_bot.settings.bind_interface="$safe_iface"; uci_commit_safe podkop_bot
14352:                 send_message "$(printf '%s Бот привязан к интерфейсу: <code>%s</code>' "$E_OK" "$safe_iface")" ""
14353:                 _handle_bot "bot_settings" "" "" ""
14354:             fi
14355:         fi
14356:         return
14357:     fi
14358: 
14359:     case "$cmd" in
14360:         # Back-compat: the /status slash-command redirects to the cmd_status
14361:         # screen. IMPORTANT: this pattern must NOT include "cmd_status" itself —
14362:         # doing so makes this branch call _handle_bot "cmd_status", which matches
14363:         # this same pattern again → unbounded recursion → the shell aborts and
14364:         # procd respawns the bot (the "Status crashes & restarts" bug). Plain
14365:         # "cmd_status" must fall through to the real renderer below.
14366:         "/status")
14367:             _handle_bot "cmd_status" "$mid" "" "" ;;
14368: 
14369:         "/start"|"/menu"|"main_menu"|"main_menu_new")
14370:             rm -f "$STATE_FILE"
14371:             # Install persistent bottom keyboard on /start or /menu
14372:             install_reply_keyboard_once
14373:             local _stop_start hostname p_ver active_proxy active_proxy_display sec sec_count sec_str text kb
14374: 
14375:             _stop_start="{\"text\":\"${E_STP} Остановить\",\"callback_data\":\"ask_cmd_stop\"}"
14376:             pidof sing-box >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
14377:                 _stop_start="{\"text\":\"${E_ON} Запустить\",\"callback_data\":\"cmd_start\"}"
14378: 
14379:             hostname=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/hostname 2>/dev/null || echo "Роутер")
14380:             p_ver=$(opkg info ${PODKOP_PKG} 2>/dev/null | grep '^Version:' | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f2 | sed 's/^v//' | cut -d'-' -f1)
14381:             [ -z "$p_ver" ] && p_ver=$(apk info ${PODKOP_PKG} 2>/dev/null | head -1 | awk '{print $1}' | sed "s/^${PODKOP_PKG}-//;s/^v//" | cut -d'-' -f1)
14382:             # Pass cached proxies to avoid extra clash_request
14383:             local proxies; proxies=$(clash_request "/proxies")
14384:             active_proxy=$(get_active_proxy_name "$proxies")
14385:             active_proxy_display=$(html_escape "$(get_active_proxy_display "$proxies")")

16770:                     fi

=== 17191-17218 ===
17191: 
17192:         # Single jq call — fields joined with U+001F (Unit Separator, not shell whitespace).
17193:         # @tsv used \t which is whitespace for read, causing field shift when callback_id empty.
17194:         # Fields: chat_id, chat_type, raw_text, callback_id, u_name, user_id,
17195:         #         is_bot_sender, sender_chat_id, sender_chat_type, sender_chat_title,
17196:         #         CALLBACK_MSG_ID, message_thread_id
17197:         _upd_flat=$(printf '%s' "$update" | jq -r '
17198:             [
17199:                 (.message.chat.id // .callback_query.message.chat.id // ""),
17200:                 (.message.chat.type // .callback_query.message.chat.type // ""),
17201:                 (.message.text // .callback_query.data // ""),
17202:                 (.callback_query.id // ""),
17203:                 (.message.from.username // .callback_query.from.username // ""),
17204:                 (.message.from.id // .callback_query.from.id // ""),
17205:                 ((.message.from.is_bot // .callback_query.from.is_bot // false) | tostring),
17206:                 (.message.sender_chat.id // .callback_query.message.sender_chat.id // ""),
17207:                 (.message.sender_chat.type // .callback_query.message.sender_chat.type // ""),
17208:                 (.message.sender_chat.title // .callback_query.message.sender_chat.title // ""),
17209:                 (.message.message_id // .callback_query.message.message_id // ""),
17210:                 (.message.message_thread_id // .callback_query.message.message_thread_id // "")
17211:             ] | join("\u001f")
17212:         ' 2>/dev/null)
17213:         IFS=$(printf '\037') read -r chat_id chat_type _raw_text callback_id u_name user_id \
17214:             is_bot_sender sender_chat_id sender_chat_type sender_chat_title \
17215:             CALLBACK_MSG_ID message_thread_id <<EOF
17216: $_upd_flat
17217: EOF
17218:         text=$(printf '%s' "$_raw_text")
